title: Boots of Elemental Momentum

sources.title: Elemental Momentum
markers: | description = Whenever the wearer deals {{DamageType|Acid}}, {{DamageType|Cold}}, {{DamageType|Fire}}, {{DamageType|Lightning}} or {{DamageType|Thunder}} damage with [[Spell]]s or [[Cantrip]], they gain {{Cond|Momentum}} for 2 turns.

summary: +1 Athletics. Deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage with a spell or cantrip to gain Momentum for 2 turns. Momentum increases speed by 5 ft per turn remaining, up to 5 turns.

fields.Effect: +1 Athletics. Deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage with a spell or cantrip to gain Momentum for 2 turns. Momentum increases speed by 5 ft per turn remaining, up to 5 turns.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
